title: Mixed Event — Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas — Episode2 Please Teach Me!

meta.Event: Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas
meta.Event Outline: Ena decides to go back to her former art class, but her teacher, Mr. Yukihira, tells her that her drawing lacks appeal. Meanwhile, Honami feels anxious about job shadowing, tasked with teaching a subject she struggles with...

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <K, Amia, I finished the illustration. Mind taking a look at it?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Send it on over.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, this overall looks good. I have no issues with it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I've looked at it too!
I just sent you a list of suggestions♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks, you two...
I'll work on making these adjustments.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <*Sigh*>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Enanan...? What's wrong?
Is something bothering you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, just something regarding my art...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Your art?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, the thing is...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <My teacher said that one of my pieces was “unappealing”. I can't get my head around what he meant since I thought I did a pretty good job.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't think he was talking about my technical skills either. I really don't understand what it is that I'm missing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Unappealing...? I'm not sure I understand either...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... I personally really like your art, Enanan, and find all your works appealing... But I guess professional artists see things pretty differently...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
Even when I think I've drawn something really good, he still manages to find all these faults.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <At the same time, I'm actually really glad that I started attending again...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's been a gradual process, but I'm finally getting my intuition back from when I was still studying properly. And I feel like I've been improving bit by bit.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see. You certainly are doing your best.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's pretty cool!
And we'll always be rooting for you!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks.
It may take a while, but I'm gonna become a lot better and draw illustrations that go much better with the music you all make, K. Just you wait.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I'll be looking forward to that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, speaking of art...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, Enanan, but would you mind doing me a favor?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <A favor? Sure, of course... How can I help?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, the housekeeper who I've been having come over is concerned about the way she draws.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She's supposed to do a shadowing at a kindergarten and has been asked to teach the children how to paint, but she doesn't have much confidence when it comes to art...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She wants to learn some tips and tricks that could help her improve, but this isn't exactly my area of expertise.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She has to teach little kids how to paint even though she can't herself? That's pretty rough. Also, kids tend to just blurt out whatever's on their minds.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Exactly. Which is why I was hoping to give some advice that would help prevent that from happening...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan, what sort of advice would you give her in this case?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What sort of advice...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... That's kinda hard to say without seeing how she draws first. Only then will I know what's actually bothering her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But this must be a huge problem for her if she's asking others for help like this.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I've never actually seen the way she draws either, but she seemed adamant about not being able to teach children based on her current level.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And I want to give back to her somehow since she's been taking such good care of me...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm not sure how much I'll be able to help, but I can try lending her a hand...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Wait, are you sure?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. You're always there to help me, K, so I want to do something to give back too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you. I really appreciate it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <However, I'm not exactly sure how we should go about doing this. Should I get a photo of her art from her and send that to you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, you're busy enough as it is composing music, so I wouldn't mind if she just sent it directly to me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, thank you...
I'll let her know to do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Again, Enanan, I really appreciate it.
And I'm sure she's going to as well.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hehe. Kanade sounds really happy. I'm glad...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm not sure I have the artistic skills necessary to teach someone else, but I want to do what I can to help...)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, let's get to work again today right away and... Hm? I got a message...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Hello. My name is Honami Mochizuki. It's nice to meet you.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I apologize for messaging you so suddenly like this, but I decided to contact you after Ms. Yoisaki let me know how to reach you.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I'd also like to apologize in advance since I know this may end up taking quite a bit of your time, but this issue is weighing on me very heavily... I would really appreciate your help.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see. So this is the girl Kanade was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And Kanade was right. She's so polite.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hello. I'm Ena Shinonome. It's nice to meet you too. I'm not what you'd call an art expert, but feel free to ask me anything. I'll answer whatever questions I can.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Thank you very much.
I really appreciate you saying that.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I'm very concerned about my artistic skills...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <My most pressing issue involves others not being able to recognize what I've drawn. No matter how hard I try.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Others not recognizing what she's drawn...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... So, she's struggling to draw what she really wants...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm gonna need to get a taste of what she's talking about before I give her any advice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Would it be possible for you to send me a picture of one of your drawings? That should make it easier for me to give you effective advice.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
...
Hm...? No reply...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess I should give her a minute. She might be taking a picture of one of her drawings.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still no reply after thirty minutes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It is getting pretty late. Maybe she fell asleep. I suppose we can pick this up...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, she replied!
What did she say...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Apologies for the late reply...
It took some time for me to draw this.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Wait, she drew something from scratch?
Hehe. She really likes to do things right, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <It's supposed to be a dog... What do you think?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A dog? Drawing a real one isn't easy, but if she's okay with something more cartoonish, I might be able to help...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What is this...?!
This black blob... It looks like a sea cucumber!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, actually it's a little more complex...
Kind of like something's organs...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
She might have a talent for abstract art...
You could even interpret this as a metaphor for something else...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, she clearly stated that she's not confident in her drawing skills. There's no way she'd be able to do something so sophisticated...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
...
How do I respond to this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-I'll start by saying...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thank you. I took a look at what you sent me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It definitely left an impression on me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure what else to say...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry...
It must've come as a big surprise...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it did...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <As you can see, my drawing skills leave much to be desired...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <No matter how much I practice or try, I just can't seem to get any better...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<So, Shinonome, please...
Can you teach me how to get better at art somehow?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: T-Teach her somehow...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<I know I'm asking a lot...
But I want to learn to draw! I want to be able to teach those kindergartners!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She seems like the hard-working type too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But you usually spend only a day or so for a shadowing. I really don't think she has to go this far...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Maybe she likes doing what she can for others...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <How about I teach you in person?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Especially since taking pictures of what you draw and sending them over every time probably has its limits.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<You'd do that...?!
But I've already taken up so much of your time...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Don't worry about that.
I also stand to learn a lot by teaching someone else how to draw.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What do you say?
That is if you're okay with it.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<No, that'd be wonderful!
I'll gladly accept your help, Shinonome!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, that settles that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But it's getting pretty late, so let's discuss when and where to meet some other time.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Yes, thank you very much!!>
